## DonutChart

`donut-chart` · Sectors ∝ value around a central readout.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `DonutChart` | `SpDonutChart` | `sp-donut-chart` | `donut_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/donut-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/donut-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/donut-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `parts`; intents `part-to-whole`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | `nameKey` | string | yes |
| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "name": "Rent", "value": 38 }, { "name": "Food", "value": 22 }, { "name": "Savings", "value": 15 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nameKey` | `Accessor<string \| number>` | `'name'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `centerValue` | `string \| number` |  | Printed in the centre; the total by default. |
| `centerLabel` | `string` |  | A line under the centre value. |
| `legend` | `boolean` | `true` | Names every sector with its share beside the ring; `true` by default. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { DonutChart } from '@silverpoint/react/donut-chart';

export function DonutChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <DonutChart
      data={rows}
      nameKey="name"
      valueKey="value"
      title="Donut chart"
    />
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { SpDonutChart } from '@silverpoint/vue/donut-chart';

defineProps<{ rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SpDonutChart
    :data="rows"
    nameKey="name"
    valueKey="value"
    title="Donut chart"
  />
</template>
```

```ts angular
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, input } from '@angular/core';
import { SpDonutChart } from '@silverpoint/angular/donut-chart';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-donut-chart-view',
  imports: [SpDonutChart],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sp-donut-chart
      [data]="rows()"
      [nameKey]="'name'"
      [valueKey]="'value'"
      [title]="'Donut chart'"
    />
  `,
})
export class DonutChartView {
  readonly rows = input.required<readonly Record<string, unknown>[]>();
}
```

## WindRose

`wind-rose` · Observations of (bearing, speed) binned by compass sector and speed.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `WindRose` | `SpWindRose` | `sp-wind-rose` | `wind_rose` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/wind-rose` | `@silverpoint/vue/wind-rose` | `@silverpoint/angular/wind-rose` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `distribution`; intents `distribution`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| bearing | `bearingKey` | number | yes |
| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "bearing": 180, "speed": 11 }, { "bearing": 170, "speed": 11 }, { "bearing": 180, "speed": 9 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bearingKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'bearing'` | Where the wind blows from, in degrees clockwise from north. Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'speed'` | The wind speed; 0 is a calm, which has no direction. Ignored without `data`. |
| `sectors` | `number` | `16` | Compass sectors: 4, 8, 16 or 32; 16 by default. |
| `bins` | `readonly number[]` | `[5, 10, 15, 20]` | Ascending speed thresholds that split each sector; `[5, 10, 15, 20]` by default. |

## VolvelleChart

`volvelle-chart` · Concentric categorical rings read against one index.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `VolvelleChart` | `SpVolvelleChart` | `sp-volvelle-chart` | `volvelle_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/volvelle-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/volvelle-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/volvelle-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `categories`; intents `schedule`, `compare`.

It draws from its props alone; `data` is not read.

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "label": "Day", "segments": [ "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun" ] }, { "label": "Shift", "segments": [ "Early", "Late", "Night" ] }, { "label": "Team", "segments": [ "Atlas", "Borealis", "Cygnus", "Draco", "Eridanus" ] } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rings` | `number` |  | Rings shown, from the inside out; all by default. |
| `indexRing` | `number` | `0` | The ring whose segment is brought under the index, 0-based; 0 by default. Without `data`, it addresses the demo’s rings: `Day`, `Shift`, `Team`. |
| `indexValue` | `string` |  | The segment of `indexRing` under the index; its first segment by default. Without `data`, it addresses the demo’s rings: `Day`, `Shift`, `Team`. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { VolvelleChart } from '@silverpoint/react/volvelle-chart';

export function VolvelleChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <VolvelleChart
      data={rows}
      title="Volvelle chart"
    />
  );
}
```

```vue

import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { SpVolvelleChart } from '@silverpoint/vue/volvelle-chart';

defineProps<{ rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SpVolvelleChart
    :data="rows"
    title="Volvelle chart"
  />
</template>
```

## OrbitChart

`orbit-chart` · Nested elliptical orbits with markers along them.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `OrbitChart` | `SpOrbitChart` | `sp-orbit-chart` | `orbit_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/orbit-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/orbit-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/orbit-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `events`; intents `schedule`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| markers | `markerKey` | array | yes |
| period | `periodKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "label": "2023", "markers": [ { "period": 0.08, "value": 12 }, { "period": 0.33, "value": 30 }, { "period": 0.61, "value": 18 }, { "period": 0.9, "value": 24 } ] }, { "label": "2024", "markers": [ { "period": 0.12, "value": 20 }, { "period": 0.4, "value": 42 }, { "period": 0.66, "value": 15 }, { "period": 0.87, "value": 33 } ] }, { "label": "2025", "markers": [ { "period": 0.05, "value": 26 }, { "period": 0.29, "value": 38 }, { "period": 0.55, "value": 50 }, { "period": 0.81, "value": 21 } ] } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orbits` | `number` |  | Orbits shown, from the inside out; all by default. |
| `markerKey` | `Accessor<readonly unknown[] \| null \| undefined>` | `'markers'` | A row's markers; `'markers'` by default. Ignored without `data`. |
| `periodKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'period'` | A marker's period, 0-1 over the cycle; `'period'` by default. Ignored without `data`. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { OrbitChart } from '@silverpoint/react/orbit-chart';

export function OrbitChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <OrbitChart
      data={rows}
      markerKey="markers"
      periodKey="period"
      title="Orbit chart"
    />
  );
}
```
